summary: Use a Form Field to collect one labelled value, such as an account number, with a hint or an error message below it.

useWhen.text: Collect one labelled value, such as an account number, with a hint or an error message below it.

from.quote: Use a Form Field to collect one labelled value, such as an account number, with a hint or an error message below it.

avoidWhen.text: The input is unlabelled chrome, a code, or a file: the Storybook docs (as the evidence records them) point to TextInput or InputSearch for unlabelled chrome, OTP for codes, and FormUpload for files.

from.quote: TextInput or InputSearch for unlabelled chrome, OTP for codes, FormUpload for files.

anatomy.holds: The label text above the field; names the value and gives the field its accessible name.

from.quote: Names the value and gives the field its accessible name.

anatomy.holds: A red asterisk beside the label, for fields people must fill in (isRequired).

from.quote: A red asterisk for fields people must fill in.

anatomy.holds: An optional 18 px icon before the text, such as the rupee sign.

from.quote: Optional 18 px icon, such as the rupee sign.

anatomy.holds: The placeholder, which shows the format, then what people type.

from.quote: The placeholder shows the format; then what people type.

anatomy.holds: The white box; its border turns purple on focus and red on error.

from.quote: White box; purple border on focus, red on error.

anatomy.holds: A hint below the field; an error message replaces it.

from.quote: A hint below the field; an error message replaces it.

placementAdvice.text: Form Field fills its container's width; the screen sets the width. The field is 47 px tall, and the label and support text sit 8 px above and below it.

from.quote: Form Field fills its container’s width. The field is 47 px tall with 12 px of padding at each end, and the label and support text sit 8 px above and below it. The screen sets the width.

placementAdvice.text: In a narrow column the field narrows with its column, and the hint wraps.

from.quote: The field narrows with its column, and the hint wraps.

placementAdvice.text: Let the screen check the values (for example when people tap Verify) and set the error on the field; Form Field only shows it, and the button stays enabled.

from.quote: The screen checks the values when people tap Verify and sets the error on the field. Form Field only shows it, and the button stays enabled.

placementAdvice.text: Keep the primary action enabled and show the error on the field; the Storybook docs say disabled is not a validation strategy.

from.quote: Keep the primary action enabled and show the error on the field

configuration.text: Every option is off unless you set it. Add an icon, an action, or the required mark when it tells people something they need.

from.quote: Every option is off unless you set it. Add an icon, an action, or the required mark when it tells people something they need.

from.quote: The default: a label, a format example, and a hint below.

configuration.text: Turn on startIcon to show the rupee icon, which marks an amount before people type.

from.quote: The rupee icon marks an amount before people type.

configuration.text: Put a small text button in trailing to act on the value without leaving the field.

from.quote: A small text button acts on the value without leaving the field.

rules.text: A clear label, a format example, and help when it goes wrong.

from.quote: A clear label, a format example, and help when it goes wrong.

examples.purpose: A field the screen marks invalid after people tap Verify; the button stays enabled.
examples.jsx:
<VStack modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <FormField
    label="IFSC code"
    placeholder="SBIN0001234"
    supportText="11 characters, on your cheque book"
    isInvalid
    errorMessage="IFSC codes have 11 characters"
    onChangeText={(text) => {}}
    modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}
  />
  <Button label="Verify account" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
</VStack>

from.quote: The screen checks the values when people tap Verify and sets the error on the field.

props.name: label
props.description: Label rendered above the input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value of the input (controlled).

props.name: onChangeText
props.description: Called when the input text changes.

props.name: type
props.description: password masks the value; email sets type=email; number sets inputmode=numeric. Declared: Logical input type. Mapped to keyboard, secure entry and capitalization. Default "text", from the component source.

props.name: name
props.description: Field name. When used inside `<Form>`, this is the key used to look up server-side `validationErrors` and to notify the form when the value changes so the error can clear.

props.name: leading
props.description: Optional element rendered before the input text (Figma start icon area). No leading element is rendered by default — the Figma FormField design hides the start icon unless toggled on.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Not hidden from assistive tech on the web: a Button there stays in the tab order after the input and keeps its name. Declared: Optional element rendered after the input text (Figma slot "end"). Typically used for an inline button (e.g. "Apply", "Show") or a status icon.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: When `true`, shows the leading icon area (Figma `startIcon`). Defaults to `false`. Uses `ic_rupee` at 18px unless `leading` or `leadingIconName` overrides it. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: leadingIconName
props.description: Convenience prop to render a built-in icon as the leading element. Ignored when `leading` is provided. When set, implies a visible start icon even if `startIcon` is omitted.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Sets aria-required on the input; the asterisk uses the Negative token. Declared: Shows a required asterisk next to the label. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Uses the Read Only colours at 50 % opacity rather than Figma's Disabled mode; sets aria-disabled and tabindex -1, so Tab skips the field. Declared: Disables interaction and dims the field. Resolves to "Read Only" state. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Sets aria-invalid on the input, and aria-describedby points at the error message. Declared: Marks the field as invalid and shows `errorMessage`. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Renders the field in read-only mode (non-interactive but not dimmed). Resolves to the "Read Only" state. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: supportText
props.description: Linked to the input (aria-describedby) while the field is valid. Declared: Helper text displayed below the input.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Replaces supportText only while isInvalid (or a Form error) is set; with isInvalid and no errorMessage, the support text turns red. Declared: Replaces `supportText` when `isInvalid` is true.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum number of characters accepted.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: When true, focuses the input on mount. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes for design token resolution.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the outermost wrapper.

props.name: inputStyle
props.description: Style overrides for the input row container.

props.name: inputTextStyle
props.description: Style overrides for the input text.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the input receives focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the input loses focus.

props.name: onSubmitEditing
props.description: Called when the user submits the input (e.g. presses return).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: The input's accessible name is accessibilityLabel, then label, then the placeholder. Declared: Accessibility label. Defaults to `label` or `placeholder`.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Accessibility hint.

props.name: testID
props.description: Test identifier.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: Dark renders identically to Light: Form Field has no dark values. Declared: A token collection FormField reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: FormField States
modes.description: Set by the component from its props: invalid → Error; read only or disabled → Read Only; focused → Active; otherwise Idle. An explicit modes['FormField States'] overrides it. Declared: A token collection FormField reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Status
modes.description: A token collection FormField reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Optional element rendered before the input text (Figma start icon area). No leading element is rendered by default — the Figma FormField design hides the start icon unless toggled on.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Optional element rendered after the input text (Figma slot "end"). Typically used for an inline button (e.g. "Apply", "Show") or a status icon.

events.name: onChangeText
events.description: Called when the input text changes.

gaps.text: Dark mode is not supported: Color Mode Dark renders like Light.
Disabled uses the read-only colours at half opacity instead of Figma's Disabled colours; the FormField States Disabled mode is never used.
No live region: an error is read when people reach the field, not when it appears.
The package field is 47 px tall; Figma's is 45 px.
